role: Commerce catalog and administrative order/review operations
known_patches: Two id arguments use integer schemas
Shared credential for id-1 Admin and Customer personas; demo tokens/accounts removed; auth realms unchanged
Existing product search supports omitted query and substring filters; review list adds optional q while preserving required product_id
limitations: No order list, inventory list, cart/cart-item list, address list, or order-comment read tool exists. Tasks must supply ids for the existing single-order reader.
product_update uses product-only upsert identity and conflates multiple attributes; it is not a verified capability.
productinventory_save is verified for existing seeded inventory rows; it lacks an inventory_source_id argument for reliable new stock-row creation.
Order/invoice/refund/shipment creation lacks nested line and financial effects; checkout_storeorder only alters Cart and does not create Order.
Order cancellation changes scalar status only; it does not restore inventory, cancel lines or enforce all upstream transition rules.
No category CRUD or general product-name/price-flat update interface exists in this tool panel; no tools invented.
